name: Curtis Industries
old_description: Curtis Industries is a specialized manufacturer of custom and standard Terminal Block and EMI/RFI Filter devices and subsystems. Founded in 1935, the company has been producing superior quality products for over eight decades. Quality is the founding principal of Curtis Industries’ manufacturing philosophy. Curtis Industries is ISO 9001:2015 and ITAR registered.  Safety approved products are certified by governing regulatory bodies such as UL, CSA, TUV, and specific regional certifying bodies as required by the customer.  Our company achieves an industry unsurpassed first pass yield on new designs. This ensures long-term customer retention as a result of optimization in our engineering methodology and process control.
about:
Curtis Industries, based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, traces its roots to 1933 when it began as a manufacturer of electrical components. The company operates as a division of Powers Holdings, Inc., a privately held corporation.

The company produces a broad line of standard and custom electrical components, including barrier and PCB terminal blocks, EMI/RFI power line filters, TRI-MAG power supplies, and custom molded assemblies. Manufacturing is performed in-house across multiple sites in Wisconsin, Arizona, Mexico, and China, encompassing plastic injection molding, transfer molding, fabrication, and rigorous testing using equipment such as an Agilent E7402A emissions analyzer.

Curtis serves OEMs and distributors in industrial instrumentation, power supply, telecommunications, medical, commercial appliance, machinery, aerospace, military, and networking sectors. Its customer base includes global 1000 organizations that rely on the firm for new product introduction support, PCB assembly, cable assemblies, system integration, and supply chain logistics.

Quality is described as the founding principle of the business. Curtis holds ISO 9001:2015 certification, ITAR registration, and UL, CSA, and TUV safety approvals. The company emphasizes an industry-leading first-pass yield on new designs, achieved through optimized engineering methodology and process control, and offers engineering design-in and material outsourcing to help clients reduce cost of goods sold.
